description:
Cheol-Yong, who has been struggling to become an idol with his extraordinary talent since he was young. However, after repeated failures, he has come to terms with reality and is now working part-time at a sushi restaurant. He meets famous composer Ruth at a house where he went to deliver fish by chance, and while he thought he would get a chance, he ended up getting entangled in a bad relationship instead. Cheol-Yong is in a situation where he could end up getting sued because Ruth, who was composing music on his clothes, suddenly starts to touch him and hits his head with a trophy. Not only that, Ruth continues to make disparaging remarks, which is really annoying. This is a do-or-die situation. An angry Cheol-Yong hands out a 'Singing Contest' poster. He proposes to Ruth that if he wins, he will not sue him and that he should give him a song. On the day of the final battle, when Cheol-Yong sharpens his sword, goes up on stage, sings, and comes down, Ruth says... "I will sue you." Instead of saying, "I will make you a star. A trot star!" Trot?! Me, who was an idol trainee?!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
